title: Yumeichan Watch Capabilities Schema
description: OCapN-compliant capability tokens for the Yumeichan Watch Interface, regulating affective disclosure, haptic engagement, and biometric telemetry on a continuous analog scale. Shape validation does not perform cryptographic signature verification.

capability_id.description: Non-empty identifier for the capability grant. It must map to a Holochain ActionHash, but the concrete ActionHash wire encoding and DHT binding are outside this shape-only schema.

grantor_pubkey.description: Non-empty Ed25519 public-key identifier for the human user granting the capability. Concrete key encoding and cryptographic verification are outside this shape-only schema.

grantee_pubkey.description: Non-empty Ed25519 public-key identifier for the Local Agent Node (Layer 4.5) receiving the capability. Concrete key encoding and cryptographic verification are outside this shape-only schema.

capability_type.description: The specific class of intimacy or sensory access granted.

analog_threshold_bounds.description: The [min, max] analog resonance bounds within which this capability is active.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-To-Live in seconds. Maximum of 2 hours (7200s) to prevent resonance flooding and unbounded intimacy.

locale_context.description: Cultural-locale context string dictating the baseline communication posture (e.g., 'direct-analytical', 'warm-prosocial').

proof.description: Required Ed25519 proof binding this grant to the RFC 8785 canonical-payload digest. Shape validation does not perform cryptographic signature verification.

payload_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the RFC 8785 canonical capability payload.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical payload digest; verification is outside schema shape validation.
